 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Happy Halloween, Cougar football fans.
 Tonight, your 1-7 Washington State Cougars are on the road to face off with the 3-5 San Diego State Aztecs in a battle of two scary bad offenses.
 Both teams enter tonight's contest not starting the quarterback they began the season with. Both WSU's Caden Pinnick and San Diego State's Jayden Denegal have been replaced by freshmen quaterbacks Owen Eshelman and Stone Saunders respectively. Both these freshmen quarterbacks have impressed since taking over but are still leading some of the worst offenses in the nation. In pure offensive success rate, WSU ranks 135th and San Diego State ranks 128th.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Cougars battled the No. 20 Boise State Broncos tough last week, going into the final quarter tied 10-10. That tie wouldn't last long however as the Broncos scored quickly to open the final quarter, then tacked on another quick touchdown after an Eshelman interception. They'd add on one more long rushing touchdown to make it 21 unanswered and escape Pullman with a 31-10 win.
 Down in Fort Collins, Colorado, the San Diego State Aztecs got in a shootout with the Colorado State Rams, but fell short 56-49. Against one of the worst defenses in the country, Saunders was able to throw for 369 yards and a pair of touchdowns while running backs Lucky Sutton and Javion Kinnard were able to run in a pair of touchdowns each. Wide receiver Jaylon Hawkins caught 164 of Saunders 369 yards on six receptions and a touchdown.
 WSU entered the season with hopes of competing for a conference title. Instead, they won't even compete for a bowl game. The Cougars suffered their seventh loss of the season last week to eliminate them from bowl contention last week before Halloween. They are still looking for their first win against an FBS opponent.
 Kickoff from Snapdragon Stadium in San Diego is at 4pm and can be watched on CBS Sports Network. Go Cougs.
